synonyms: cost of goods sold; cost of sales; product cost; COGS EUR; production variance; varukostnad
short_definition: Cost of goods sold: debits minus credits on GL accounts in account group COGS (4000 standard cost of goods sold, 4100 production variances), in group currency EUR, for posted documents.

synonyms: fiscal year; fiscal month; accounting period; posting period; FY; quarter; period; räkenskapsår
short_definition: Fjällmark's fiscal year equals the calendar year and each fiscal period is one calendar month (1–12); quarters are periods 1–3, 4–6, 7–9, 10–12. The last closed period in the data is September 2026.

synonyms: gross profit; GM; gross margin %; GM%; margin; bruttomarginal; bruttovinst
short_definition: Gross Margin = Net Revenue − COGS, in EUR from the general ledger; Gross Margin % = Gross Margin ÷ Net Revenue.

synonyms: group currency; reporting currency; EUR; euro; FX; exchange rate; currency conversion; local currency; company code currency
short_definition: EUR is Fjällmark's group reporting currency. Amounts in different currencies (SEK, NOK, DKK, PLN, EUR) may only be added after conversion to EUR; the general ledger stores the EUR amount on every line.

synonyms: revenue; net sales; sales; turnover; top line; official revenue; finance revenue; nettoomsättning
short_definition: The official revenue of Fjällmark: credits minus debits on GL accounts in account group REVENUE, in group currency EUR, excluding VAT and shipping fees, after DTC returns and B2B trade discounts, for DTC and B2B together.

synonyms: standard cost per unit; unit cost; cost estimate; product cost; standardkostnad; cost roll-up
short_definition: The planned (standard) manufacturing cost of one unit of a SKU, split into raw material, packaging, labour, overhead and freight-in components; used to value inventory and to post standard COGS.

synonyms: legal entity; entity; company; subsidiary; bolag; Buchungskreis; SE01; DE01
short_definition: A company code is one of Fjällmark's six legal entities (SE01, NO01, DK01, FI01, DE01, PL01). Every transaction belongs to exactly one company code, which also determines its local currency and the data an analyst is allowed to see.

synonyms: DSO; days sales outstanding; debtor days; collection period; receivable days; kundfordringsdagar
short_definition: How many days of credit sales are tied up in open trade receivables: open AR at the reporting date ÷ (credit sales billed in the last quarter ÷ days in the quarter), per company code, as of 2026-09-30 (Q3 2026 = 92 days).

synonyms: overdue AR; past due; overdue invoices; aged receivables; AR aging; förfallna fordringar; late payments
short_definition: The unpaid balance of customer invoices whose due date has passed at the reporting date (2026-09-30), analysed in aging buckets by days past due.

synonyms: active customer; active consumer; active buyer; buying customer; active shoppers; aktiv kund; 12-month active
short_definition: A registered shopper who placed at least one non-cancelled webshop order in the 12 months up to the reporting date (2026-09-30). This behavioural definition differs from the CRM field shopper.lifecycle_status = 'active'.

synonyms: customer lifetime value segment; CLV segment; value segment; customer segment; at risk; churned; high value customers
short_definition: The customer-lifetime-value segment of a shopper (high_value, mid_value, low_value, at_risk, churned) from shopper.cltv_segment; at_risk means no webshop order in the last 180 days.

synonyms: consent; GDPR; marketing consent; opt-in; opt-out; permission to contact; contactable; samtycke; DSGVO
short_definition: Whether Fjällmark may contact or profile a shopper: the current, granted consent record per shopper and consent type (marketing e-mail, SMS, push, data sharing, profiling, cookies) under GDPR.

synonyms: AOV; average basket; basket size; average order size; average ticket; snittorder; genomsnittligt ordervärde
short_definition: Average net merchandise value per non-cancelled webshop order: Σ (subtotal − discount) ÷ number of orders, excl. VAT and shipping, per currency.

synonyms: GMV; gross merchandise value; webshop sales; DTC sales; online sales; e-commerce sales; order value; webshop revenue
short_definition: The value of merchandise ordered on the webshop before discounts, VAT, shipping and returns (Σ unit price × quantity ordered of non-cancelled orders), in the market's local currency. An operational DTC KPI — not Fjällmark's revenue.

synonyms: order status; cancelled orders; cancellations; open orders; delivered orders; returned orders; order lifecycle; orderstatus
short_definition: The lifecycle state of a webshop order (pending, confirmed, processing, shipped, delivered, returned, cancelled) and which states count as sales: everything except cancelled.

synonyms: returns; return %; returned orders; returned items; refund rate; returrate; Retourenquote
short_definition: Share of webshop merchandise that consumers send back: returned order-line net value ÷ total order-line net value of non-cancelled orders (value-based); about 5–6 % of DTC order lines are returned.

synonyms: subscribe and save; auto-replenishment; subscription box; recurring order; active subscriptions; subscription churn; prenumeration; Abo
short_definition: A shopper's recurring webshop plan (granola box, oat-drink crates, Mjuk Care refills) that generates an order every cycle; counted as active when subscription_status = 'active'. Recurring value = net price per cycle in local currency.

synonyms: tier; membership tier; membership level; Fjällmark Friends tier; Bronze; Silver; Gold; Platinum; member status
short_definition: The membership level of a Fjällmark Friends loyalty member — Bronze, Silver, Gold or Platinum (rank 1–4) — which sets the points multiplier, member discount and free shipping.

synonyms: manufacturing facility; factory; site; production site; fabrik; Werk; Lund; Norrköping; Tampere; Poznań
short_definition: One of Fjällmark's four manufacturing facilities — Lund (SE-LUN), Norrköping (SE-NKP), Tampere (FI-TMP) and Poznań (PL-POZ) — stored in manufacturing.manufacturing_facility and referenced by every production fact.

synonyms: line; manufacturing line; filling line; packaging line; PL-POZ-L2; produktionslinje; Linie
short_definition: A physical production line inside a plant (16 in total, e.g. PL-POZ-L2 = Poznań liquid filling for shampoo and body wash), stored in manufacturing.production_line with its type, design speed, OEE and scrap targets.

synonyms: downtime minutes; line stops; unplanned downtime; stoppage; breakdown time; stillestånd; Stillstandszeit
short_definition: Minutes a production line did not produce during planned production time, recorded per production order (production_order.downtime_minutes); reported per line, plant and month. Changeover time is tracked separately.

synonyms: OEE; overall equipment effectiveness; line efficiency; equipment effectiveness; availability performance quality; utnyttjandegrad; Gesamtanlageneffektivität
short_definition: OEE = Availability × Performance × Quality of a production line, in percent (0–100). Fjällmark reports OEE per production order (production_order.oee_percentage) and aggregates it as the average over completed orders by plant, line and month.

synonyms: cost variance; production variance; actual vs planned cost; cost overrun; manufacturing variance; Kostenabweichung
short_definition: Actual minus planned cost of production orders (production_order.actual_cost − planned_cost), in the plant's local currency; positive = overrun. Posted to finance as production variances (GL account 4100).

synonyms: order status; production status; released orders; completed production orders; TECO; CNF; SAP order status
short_definition: The SAP-style lifecycle status of a production order: CRTD created, REL released, PCNF partially confirmed, CNF confirmed, DLV delivered, TECO technically complete, CLSD closed. Completed = CNF, DLV, TECO or CLSD.

synonyms: on-time completion; on-time completion rate; schedule attainment; production on time; late production orders; leveransprecision produktion; Termintreue
short_definition: Share of finished production orders whose actual finish date is on or before the scheduled finish date (production_order.actual_finish_timestamp vs scheduled_finish_date), per plant, line and month.

synonyms: scrap; scrap %; waste rate; reject rate; kassation; Ausschussquote; spoilage
short_definition: Scrap rate = scrapped quantity ÷ input quantity, in percent, from manufacturing.yield_record; compared with the line target production_line.scrap_rate_target_percent.

synonyms: production yield; first pass yield; yield %; output yield; material yield; utbyte; Ausbeute
short_definition: Yield = good output quantity ÷ input quantity of a production step, in percent; recorded per production order and batch in manufacturing.yield_record (actual_yield_percentage) with loss reasons. Fjällmark lines normally run at about 97 %.
